products.name: Charades
products.tagline: Dumb charades for the room you are already in.
products.blurb: 5,149 cards across Bollywood, Tollywood, Hollywood and Family & Kids. Fully offline, no daily limits.
products.modelDetail: You pay once and keep it. There are 32 things you can buy — 28 individual packs and 4 industry bundles. Each is a single payment that restores on a new phone from your store account. No subscription, and no ad SDK anywhere in the project.

ios.label: Staged, not submitted
ios.note: 1.0.30 is built and signed; the App Store submit has not been made

features.title: Four packs, 5,149 cards
features.body: Bollywood, Tollywood, Hollywood, Family & Kids. Enough that a group will not see a repeat in a night.

features.title: Entirely offline
features.body: Every card ships inside the app. Aeroplane mode, a basement, a road trip — it does not care.

features.title: Tilt to score
features.body: Down for got it, up for pass — the way everyone already plays it.

permissions.name: Billing
permissions.why: Only if you buy a pack. Handled by the store, never by us.

permissions.name: Vibration
permissions.why: The buzz when a round ends.

permissions.name: Not requested
permissions.why: No camera, microphone, contacts, location or storage — and no network permission for gameplay.

products.name: Tic Tac Toe
products.blurb: Two players on one device, or a minimax AI that never loses on Hard.
products.modelDetail: Free to install with nothing to buy. It is paid for by a banner at the bottom of the board and a full-screen ad when a game ends — which means it needs a network, and the ad network receives an advertising identifier from your device. There is no ad-free tier. If that trade is not one you want, no other app of mine has ads at all.

adSurfaces.where: Bottom of the board, always on screen
Full screen, when a game finishes

features.title: Two players on one phone
features.body: Pass and tap. No accounts, no lobby, no second device to pair.

features.title: A perfect opponent
features.body: Three AI levels. Hard runs minimax, so it draws or wins — it cannot be beaten.

features.title: Running score
features.body: Kept across a session, so a best-of-seven actually resolves.

permissions.name: Network
permissions.why: Required — it is what fetches the ads.

permissions.name: Ad identifier
permissions.why: Asked for on iOS via the system prompt. Declining costs you nothing.

permissions.name: Not requested
permissions.why: No camera, microphone, contacts, location or storage.

products.name: Aakalan
products.tagline: Your expenses and everyone else's, on one ledger.
products.blurb: Split with friends and flatmates, and settle over UPI without leaving the app.
products.modelDetail: It charges again every month or every year until you cancel. Cancelling happens in your Google Play or App Store account rather than in the app — we cannot cancel it for you — and access runs to the end of the period you already paid for. There is a free tier and it is not time-limited.

tiers.label: Annual
tiers.note: Charged every year until cancelled. Works out to ₹62 a month.

android.label: Closed testing only
android.note: Play Console declarations pending; alpha is the ceiling

features.title: One ledger, not two apps
features.body: Track your own spending and shared spending in the same place, instead of two apps that disagree.

features.title: Split anything
features.body: With friends, flatmates or colleagues, in whatever proportion you agreed on.

features.title: Settle over UPI
features.body: Settlement is immediate — no confirmation step the other person has to remember.

permissions.name: Contacts
permissions.why: Only to pick who you are splitting with. Read-only — writing to contacts is blocked outright.

permissions.name: Camera & photos
permissions.why: Attaching a receipt to an expense. Optional.

permissions.name: Network
permissions.why: A shared ledger has to sync. Your data lives in Firestore in the Mumbai region.

permissions.name: Analytics
permissions.why: None. There is no analytics SDK in this app.

products.name: Imposter
products.tagline: Everyone gets the word. Except one of you.
products.blurb: Social deduction for 3–20 people on one phone.
products.priceNote: 3 packs free, rest in one payment
products.modelDetail: Three categories will be free with no time limit. The other seven are a single payment — no subscription, nothing that renews, and no ad SDK in the project at all. The price is not set yet, so there is no number on this page.

android.label: Closed testing, not public
android.note: Production track has never had a release

products.unreleasedNote: Neither store has a public release yet. The build is finished and in review on iOS; the Android production track has never had a release. Rather than link a testing URL that most people cannot open, there is no button here until a track is genuinely open.

features.title: A hint, hand-written
features.body: The Imposter sees one word of help, written by a person for that exact word — not generated.

features.title: Mr. White sees nothing
features.body: And can still steal the round by naming the word at the end.

features.title: No analytics, at all
features.body: There is no analytics SDK in the project. Nothing about your rounds leaves the phone.

permissions.name: Not requested
permissions.why: None declared at all. The app makes exactly one network call, to the purchase service.

products.name: AskCal
products.tagline: A calorie counter that admits what it cannot see.
products.blurb: Every value is marked Seen, Guessed or Unknown, resolved against USDA data.
products.modelDetail: It charges again every month or every year until you cancel, in your store account rather than in the app. There is a metered free tier — ten scans — before anything is charged.
products.offline: No — scans run on a server

android.label: Internal testing only
android.note: In review on the closed track

ios.label: Not started
ios.note: No iOS build has been uploaded

products.unreleasedNote: Nothing is installable today. We would rather say that than show a button that goes nowhere.

features.title: Seen
features.body: Visible in the photo and identified.

features.title: Guessed
features.body: Inferred from the dish, with the assumption stated out loud.

features.title: Unknown
features.body: It asks one or two questions instead of filling in a number.

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.why: Photographing a meal. It is the whole product.

permissions.name: Photo library
permissions.why: Picking a photo you already took.

permissions.name: Network
permissions.why: Required — the scan runs on a server, not on the phone.

screens: A result with all three labels

products.name: Chitragupt
products.tagline: Household tax review for salaried Indian filers.
products.blurb: Upload a Form 16, see both regimes side by side, and print the refund you can actually claim.
products.modelDetail: Not a subscription and not quite one-time. Each assessment year is its own purchase, so the charge repeats annually — but only if you come back. Nothing auto-renews. Which regime wins, and by how much, is free; the full workings and the household lens are the paid tiers.

tiers.label: Self
tiers.note: One filer, both regimes, the full result.

tiers.label: Household
tiers.note: Spouse, parents and kids on one return.

products.offline: No — it is a web app
products.analyticsNote: The only product of mine that carries analytics. It asks before anything is collected.

features.title: Form 16 in, structured return out
features.body: Parses the upload rather than asking you to retype it.

features.title: Both regimes, side by side
features.body: With the delta stated in rupees, not drawn as a chart.

features.title: A household lens
features.body: Spouse, parents and kids — and the deductions that only exist across people.

legal.privacyNote: The policy lives on chitragupt.ai, where it is a real page of the product rather than a copy.

products.name: Plan-Kid
products.tagline: A parenthood journey app for couples in India.
products.blurb: From the pre-decision stage through to parenting.
products.modelDetail: Planned as an annual subscription. Nothing is charged today because nothing is built.

products.name: DwarSeva Property
products.blurb: Every listing verified by a human, with a ₹5-per-action friction filter so only serious enquiries get through.
